Building relationships with vascular surgeons, interventionalists, theatre teams, procurement and hospital purchasing stakeholders. Driving adoption of the wider product portfolio, including key growth products within vascular and surgical applications. Supporting customers in theatre and attending procedures where appropriate. Delivering product training, workshops and first-use support. Managing both clinician-led and procurement-led sales processes. Preparing customer quotations and proposals. Confidence engaging with clinicians, theatre teams, procurement and other hospital stakeholders. Strong territory management, planning and organisational skills.
